events.content:
Created `/admin` with a per-request session check. The page calls Next.js’s `forbidden()` when the session is missing or its role is not `admin`, and [the custom 403 page](/workspace/app/admin/forbidden.tsx) shows an access-denied message with a link home. I enabled the required auth boundary setting in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts).

The production build passed. With the current mock session, `/admin` returned **HTTP 403** and displayed the custom page. An admin session will render [the dashboard](/workspace/app/admin/page.tsx).
